What's new in 0.1.84:
• Android: audio keeps playing with the screen off, and Home during a video opens Picture-in-Picture. Both are on by default and can be switched off.
• Settings recovery now prefers the newest normal backup copy over one with a future date.
• The Play button on a movie in a collection no longer picks the wrong film, and no film is listed twice.
• Car Party, Watch Party and audiobook fixes on Android.
• More automatic tests.
• Tested by hand only on one Samsung S9+ (screen-off audio and Picture-in-Picture worked). Not tried on a brand-new install or other phones, and the Windows upgrade is untried.
• Built from commit a79ed0d21, Oct 9, 2026, 8:35 AM Eastern.
